_comment: Global limits retain their existing calibration. Per-phoneme overrides use worst observed + 3 sample SDs, rounded outward, from 30 non-overlapping 200,000-word bare-lexicon streams. The /z/ ratio and /n/ gap overrides accept the reviewed distribution tradeoff from preserving legal root codas before optional extensions. All other per-phone bounds, total variation and fixed-zero inventory requirements remain unchanged. This engineering margin is not a false-failure probability guarantee. See TUNING.md and archive/pr-313-recalibration for development and confirmation evidence.
